sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (₹5L–₹20L referenced in sub-limit table)

room_rent.note: Standard A/C room (single occupancy with attached washroom, excludes suite). Proportionate deduction applies if higher room taken.

icu.note: ICU expenses paid at actuals as per policy wording.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay in base plan. Optional voluntary co-pay of 5%/10%/15%/20% available for premium discount. If Cashless Discount optional cover is opted, 20% co-pay applies on reimbursement claims.

sub_limits.note: Inbuilt cataract sub-limit: 10% of SI per eye, max ₹50,000. Optional cover adds sub-limits for cardiac, joints, hernia, calculi, hysterectomy, gall bladder, spine, cancer, chronic kidney/liver, infectious conditions.

deductible.note: Voluntary aggregate deductible of ₹10k–₹3L available as optional discount feature.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt.

ped_waiting.note: 36 months continuous coverage required. Reducible via portability credit from prior insurer.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Covers cataract, hernia, calculi, hysterectomy, organ transplant, piles, fistula, prostate, hydrocele, benign tumours, cirrhosis, arthroplasty, dementia, bariatric surgery and others.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered. No optional maternity add-on mentioned.

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% of base SI added per claim-free year, max 100%. Reduces at same rate on claim. Optional Super Cumulative Bonus add-on offers up to 200% at 25%/yr.

restoration.note: Sum Insured Reinstatement is an optional cover. Options: once per policy year or unlimited times per policy year. Subsequent hospitalisation must be after 2-day gap from discharge (waived for different insured). Not available for organ donor or modern treatment claims.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 30 days prior to admission.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days after discharge.

day_care.note: Extensive indicative list in Annexure I; any procedure requiring <24 hrs due to technology also covered.

domiciliary.note: Covered up to SI; must exceed 3 days. Excludes asthma, bronchitis, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, arthritis, gastroenteritis, psychiatric disorders, pyrexia of unknown origin, vector-borne diseases.

ayush.note: AYUSH hospitalisation (min 24 hrs) covered up to In-patient SI. Comfort treatments and OPD excluded.

organ_donor.note: Harvesting expenses for organ donor covered up to SI. Pre/post-hospitalisation of donor not covered. Restoration benefit not applicable.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered at reasonable & customary charges up to In-patient SI for emergency transfer and inter-hospital transfer.

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemo, intra-vitreal injections, HIFU, deep brain stimulation, etc.) covered up to SI. Cumulative bonus and restoration not applicable for this cover.

consumables.note: Non-medical consumables listed in Annexure II are excluded. No optional consumables rider mentioned.

global_cover.note: Policy covers treatment within India only.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim can be contested except for fraud and permanent exclusions.

grace_period.note: 30 days for all modes except monthly premium where it is 15 days.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period at inception only; not applicable at renewal or porting.

portability.note: IRDAI portability norms apply; apply at least 30 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions.display: No overseas treatment, domiciliary excludes diabetes/hypertension/asthma, spectacles/hearing aids, external congenital anomalies, vaccination

optional_riders.display: Sum Insured Reinstatement (once/unlimited), Super Cumulative Bonus (up to 200%), Disease Sub-limits, Cashless Discount, Accidental Death Cover, No Claim Discount
